name: linear
title: Linear
description: Editable Linear timestamp ingestion with archived issues and complete paginated comments.

changes: Sync issues through overlapping updated-time windows, explicitly including archived issues.
Collect all accessible comment pages and advance the watermark only after the complete window reaches the destination.
Use paginate for issue and comment connections, with one executor retry boundary per HTTP request and validation of provider continuations.
Separate editable source configuration, injectable HTTP client, resource reader, and pipeline wiring; test configuration binding and isolated installation checkpoints.

resources.name: issues
resources.title: Issues
resources.description: Archived and active issues updated inside a timestamp window, with all accessible comment pages.

setup: Provide LINEAR_API_KEY with read access to the selected resources.
Keep the API key in the runtime environment and rotate it according to the provider policy.

sync.description: Issues use bounded updatedAt windows, five-minute overlap and whole-window checkpoints after destination acknowledgement.
sync.schedule: Run bunx chkit ingest run --tag provider:linear from a scheduler.
sync.deletions: Deleted issues remain stored. Periodic historical reconciliation refreshes comments whose changes may not update the parent issue.
